caption: The cheque example worked step by step: 1200 × 800 pixels at 8 bits each gives 960,000 bytes, that is 0.96 MB for one copy, and three copies come to 2.88 MB. Every step is the one in the text, in the same order.

spec.title: Cheque image size, step by step
spec.aria: A five-step chain finding the storage of a 1200 by 800 pixel cheque at 8 bits per pixel: 960,000 pixels, 7,680,000 bits, 960,000 bytes which is 0.96 MB, and 2.88 MB for three copies.
